user.title: Connect to EMS-ESP
user.description: Read HC1, own 1. The dashboard can write this schedule after an explicit admin Save. Enter a hostname or HTTP(S) origin and API key. Validation reads all 42 slots and can take up to 3 minutes. The selector POST requires an API key with command permission.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace API key
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement key. Validation reads all 42 slots.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid hostname or HTTP(S) origin without credentials or a path, and a non-empty API key.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check its command permissions.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach EMS-ESP or complete the request. Check the host and network.
error.invalid_response: The complete 42-slot schedule could not be verified. Check firmware compatibility and avoid concurrent switchtime readers.
